absence.descriptionShort: Email template about absence to employees at work
absence.descriptionLong: Allows to define in which days the employee was absent and exactly for what reason. Considering the hours of the week or month. Clearly shows the report of each week on the specific hours of work  the employee with own photo.

access-token.descriptionShort: Email template about generating an access token
access-token.descriptionLong: Allows to inform the user that a new access token has been created for their account. Shows when the token was generated and from which device or location. Sends directly to the security settings by the button to revoke it if not recognized.

account-deleted.descriptionShort: Email template confirming an account deletion
account-deleted.descriptionLong: Allows to confirm that a user's account and its data have been permanently deleted. Shows the date the account was removed and a short summary of what happens next. Gives a contact link in case the deletion was not requested.

activities.descriptionShort: Email template related to the activities
activities.descriptionLong: Allows to define the time with the kilometers spent on the activity at the given time. It shows the exact distance traveled and the number of people who "like it". In addition, the template allows you to add photos and shows the weather during activity.

blog-post.descriptionShort: Email template about posted blog posts
blog-post.descriptionLong: Allows to create an e-mail about new posts that just appeared on the blog. Shows a part of  content along with a photo and title. Refers to the entire text or other posts posted on the blog.

calendar.descriptionShort: Email template with a calendar of events
calendar.descriptionLong: Allows to show a list of upcoming events over the month, each with its date and short description. Highlights the closest event separately. Refers to the full calendar on the website by the button.

changelog.descriptionShort: Email template with a product changelog
changelog.descriptionLong: Allows to list the latest changes, fixes and new features added to the product. Groups items by category and shows the release date. Sends to the full changelog page by the button.

collection.descriptionShort: Email template about the proposition of the collection
collection.descriptionLong: Shows preferred themed blogs to follow. The template shows the five best blogs along with their short description with a photo, link to the subscription and the author of the text. Also shows another collections for scroll contents.

company-email.descriptionShort: Email template for internal company communication
company-email.descriptionLong: Allows to share company news and announcements with employees. Shows the sender's name and department along with the message content. Includes a button to read the full announcement on the intranet.

conference.descriptionShort: Email template with an invitation to a conference
conference.descriptionLong: Allows to include a short description of the conference along with the topics discussed during the event. Describes who will run the conferences and for what reason. Also shows the time of start the conference and direct registration button on the website.

confirm-email.descriptionShort: Email template to confirm a new email address
confirm-email.descriptionLong: Allows to verify that a newly added email address belongs to the user. Shows the address to be confirmed and explains why confirmation is needed. Sends directly to the confirmation page by the button.

confirmation.descriptionShort: Email template with the booking confirmation
confirmation.descriptionLong: Allows to create an email with all  important information about the reservation. Shows important details about sales. Confirms the reservation and shows the amount paid along with the date of purchase and definite place.

deployment-failed.descriptionShort: Email template about a failed deployment
deployment-failed.descriptionLong: Allows to notify the team that a deployment did not complete successfully. Shows the project name, the failed step and the time it happened. Sends to the build logs by the button to investigate the cause.

domain-configuration.descriptionLong: Allows to guide the user through connecting a custom domain. Shows the required DNS records and their current verification status. Sends to the domain settings by the button to finish the setup.

download.descriptionShort: Email template with message about the completed download
download.descriptionLong: Shows which link is ready to download items. Confirms the number of attachments downloaded along with its size.Shows how many times you can click on a definite file and the time of expiry.

empty.descriptionLong: Allows to create your own content proper for users. Add information that are not in the templates. For example a personal note or reminder about a specific event, etc. for your company

error.descriptionShort: Email template with informaton about the error
error.descriptionLong: Allows to reduce the number of errors in the software. Describes the problem that related with the HTML code. Automatically sends to debug your content. Identifies the cause of the failure and allows to the remove. Shows the date of error.

event-invitation.descriptionShort: Email template with an invitation to a event
event-invitation.descriptionLong: Allows to create an email showing a new user group. Informs about the just formed group with short description and support to join in. It shows people who have already joined and automatically sends you to registration.

featured-photo.descriptionShort: Email template with the featured photo
featured-photo.descriptionLong: Allows to show the most popular photograph with the author and the date of publication from a given month. Shows the number of people who liked the photo. In addition shows following pictures, which may also be liked.

features.descriptionLong: Allows to popularize a new software feature. It presents in detail what is involved with the HTML code. Shows simple and quick modifications. Offers a trial version, just press the button. Each description is with a picture.

features-2.descriptionLong: Allows  to display the latest added features with a description and picture. Shortly describes each of new features and presents how to use it. Shows only the selected new functions, and sends to the rest of them by the button.

features-3.descriptionLong: Allows to showcase a set of product features with an icon and short description for each. Groups the features so they are easy to scan. Sends to the features page by the button for more details.

footer-1.descriptionShort: Email footer template with social links
footer-1.descriptionLong: Shows a simple footer block with the company logo, social media icons and an unsubscribe link. Fits at the bottom of any email template. Keeps the layout compact and consistent with the rest of the message.

footer-2.descriptionShort: Email footer template with contact details
footer-2.descriptionLong: Shows a footer block with the company address, phone number and support email. Includes links to the privacy policy and unsubscribe page. Fits at the bottom of any email template.

footer-3.descriptionShort: Email footer template with navigation links
footer-3.descriptionLong: Shows a footer block with links to the main sections of the website. Includes the company logo and copyright notice. Fits at the bottom of any email template.

footer-4.descriptionShort: Email footer template with app download links
footer-4.descriptionLong: Shows a footer block promoting the mobile app with App Store and Google Play buttons. Includes the company logo and an unsubscribe link. Fits at the bottom of any email template.

friend-request.descriptionShort: Email template for a friend request
friend-request.descriptionLong: Allows to send a separate invitation to friends. Email show the photo of the person who sends the invitation along with the name. You can accept or refuse the invitation any time. Below it is information from which platform the invitation came from.

gdpr.descriptionLong: Shows an email template which is adapted to changes in user data. It protects individual, personal data, privacy the free flow of content. Include content about the elementary legal conditions of users.

help.descriptionShort: Email template with help to users
help.descriptionLong: Allows specify the occurs problem with a quick solution. Presents the most popular questions related to the theme of the problem and answers. Additionally, automatically moves to live chat  to find a solution.

invitation.descriptionShort: Email template with an invitation to collaborate
invitation.descriptionLong: Shows whos and for what purpose invites to cooperate.Viev the entire invitation by clicking on the button or visiting the profile of the person who invites you to learn a little more about them. In addition accept or reject the invitation any time.

invitation-2.descriptionShort: Email template with an invitation to collaborate
invitation-2.descriptionLong: Shows who invites the user and to which project or team. Explains what access will be granted once the invitation is accepted. Accepts or declines the invitation by the button at any time.

invoice.descriptionLong: Shows the exact details of the payer with the purchased items on the pictures. Shows the amount of purchased goods including tax and the final amount. Shows the date of purchase and a direct button to print the invoice or contact with the company.

last-conversation.descriptionShort: Email template with the last conversation
last-conversation.descriptionLong: Allows to view the last conversation with the selected person. It presents a fragment of the conversation. To read all conversation click on the button 'read more'. Instead of names of users, shows a photo of them.

license.descriptionShort: Email template related with the license
license.descriptionLong: Allows to create an email related to the acquired license by the user. There is the name of the purchased service, the registration code to  activated and the details of the license, always with date expiration at the end.

magic-link.descriptionShort: Email template with a magic link to sign in
magic-link.descriptionLong: Allows to sign in without a password by sending a one-time link to the user's email. Shows how long the link stays valid before it expires. Sends directly to the account by the button.

message.descriptionShort: Email template with a new message
message.descriptionLong: Allows for quick response, informing that the user has responded to our message. Shows from who the message comes from and shows the written content. Below are the buttons for direct response or for managing reservations

missing-order.descriptionShort: Email template with the missing order
missing-order.descriptionLong: Shows the shopping list in the basket. Sends products along with photos that were in the basket and expect realization. Offers an additional discount when transaction will complete. Also sends back by the button to continue the order.

new-app.descriptionShort: Email template announcing a new app
new-app.descriptionLong: Allows to introduce a newly released application to users. Shows a short description of what the app does along with a preview image. Sends to the download page by the button.

new-photos.descriptionShort: Email template about new photos added
new-photos.descriptionLong: Allows to notify the user that new photos have been added to an album or gallery. Shows a preview of the latest photos along with who added them. Sends to the full gallery by the button.

newsletter.descriptionLong: Shows the latest information, messages in blog posts on thematic blogs or social networks. It presents articles that may interested the user. Clicking by on "read more", the button moves to the whole text to the read.

off-deals.descriptionLong: Allows to present a list of products currently on sale with their discounted price. Shows the discount percentage and how long the deal lasts. Sends directly to the store by the button.

offer.descriptionLong: Allows to create an email witht the discount on product. It presents an interesting offer for users, which saves money. There is a description of what the offer is about, along with the expiry date of the offer. Sends by a button to get a discount.

order.descriptionLong: Shows the order with the purchased products. Displays the order number along with the necessary information and the total cost and date of purchase. Underneath shows the proposed items and 'back to shop' button to buy something else.

otp-code.descriptionShort: Email template with a one-time password code
otp-code.descriptionLong: Allows to send a one-time code used to verify the user's identity. Shows how long the code stays valid before it expires. Reminds the user not to share the code with anyone.

password.descriptionShort: Email template with reset password for the account
password.descriptionLong: Allows to send a generated message with instructions to change the password when you forget it. Using the button, we move to the page to give a new password. Below there is a URL adress where you can find more information about changing the password.

payment.descriptionLong: Shows an email template with the exact cost of the transaction along with information about the date, method of payment and invoice confirmation. An additional option is add a loan function from the  minimum amount.

popular-posts.descriptionLong: Shows in the email the most viewed posts by users with the beginning of the text from the blog with the picture. Below are the next popular posts with the referring button to read more articles on thematic blogs.

post.descriptionShort: Email template about a new post
post.descriptionLong: Allows to notify followers when a new post is published. Shows the title, a short excerpt and the cover image of the post. Sends to the full post by the button.

pricing.descriptionShort: Email template with the given pricing
pricing.descriptionLong: Shows price offers along with attractive discounts between different packages. Each package contains various options and a different price. Each package satisfies different user needs. Through the "update" button moves to purchase the offer.

product-available.descriptionShort: Email template with an available product
product-available.descriptionLong: Allows to send an offer that was not currently available. Shows a specific product with photo and price. Use the button to refer to the website to purchase the product. Below are products that may also interest the recipient.

progress.descriptionLong: Shows the overall progress of the user at a given time related to the activity. Thanks to the graph, clearly describes the progress. Defines the day on which the activity took place along with the necessary information about it.

projects.descriptionShort: Email template with a project overview
projects.descriptionLong: Allows to show employees' projects. Shows with the graph the percentage of the completed project along with a description of what it concerns and the person who coordinates the project. Using the button, it refers to managing all projects

promo-code.descriptionShort: Email template associated with promo code.
promo-code.descriptionLong: Shows specially generated code for users to take uses of the promotion. Specifies the type and amount of the discount and its expiration date. It sends directly to the store to buy a product at a lower price than at the beginning.

promotions.descriptionShort: Email template with a list of promotions
promotions.descriptionLong: Allows to present several ongoing promotions in a single email. Shows each offer with its own image, description and expiry date. Sends directly to the store by the button for each offer.

promotions-2.descriptionShort: Email template with a featured promotion
promotions-2.descriptionLong: Allows to highlight one main promotion with a large image and short description. Shows the discount and the expiry date of the offer. Sends directly to the store by the button.

register.descriptionShort: Email template about the registration of a new user
register.descriptionLong: Allows to confirm your data and complete registration of a new user in the system. It presents what the registration is about, along with the "confirm your email address" button. At the end is display thanks for registration

reminder.descriptionShort: Email template with an event reminder
reminder.descriptionLong: Allows to create an email referring to the private calendar. Sends notification of upcoming events with the date and place of the meeting. In addition, below are details of what the meeting is about, along with button to confirm your arrival.

repo-stats.descriptionLong: Shows financial transactions that regulate the liquidity of the banking sector. Presents a statistics graph and also open and closed problems together with new. Through photos  shows current management intermediaries

review.descriptionShort: Email template asking for a review
review.descriptionLong: Allows to ask the user to leave a review after a purchase or an interaction. Shows the product or service along with a star rating widget. Sends to the review form by the button.

sale.descriptionLong: Shows ready text with photo in which it informs about the promotion. Offers a specific discount percentage along with a time limit. In addition, it refers directly to the purchase of the offer. Indicates which time the promotion is active.

schedule.descriptionShort: Email template connected with the schedule
schedule.descriptionLong: Allows to organize time at work with accurate employee data. Shows the status of the employee along with the time worked on a particular day. Employees are represented by a photo with the profession they perform.

security-alert.descriptionShort: Email template with a security alert
security-alert.descriptionLong: Allows to warn the user about a suspicious sign-in attempt or account activity. Shows the device, location and time of the activity. Sends directly to the security settings by the button to secure the account.

shipped.descriptionShort: Email template informing about the shipment
shipped.descriptionLong: Allows to create an email which all the inportant details of the purchase. Email informs you that the product has been sent. Contains the tracking number of the shipment and the name of the company through which the product was sent.

stats.descriptionLong: Allows on the graph to present statistics on website visits. Shows how many users have used the site at any given time. It divides users into those who have used the site and those who do not. It refers to the entire report by the button.

stats-2.descriptionLong: Shows company statistics on graph from a specific time with a specific system update that was entered. Shows the percentage of people who benefited from it, who were satisfied and those who rejected the update. Refers to full report.

subscribe.descriptionLong: Allows to send emails about proposed subscriptions. Every suggestion presents a short description of the application with logo. Next to each is a button that refers to the automatic subscription of the application. It also has a button to see more.

subscription.descriptionShort: Email template about confirmation of subscription
subscription.descriptionLong: Allows you to send an email about the request to accept the subscription. The message informs that thanks to the subscription the user will be up to date with new products. Refer by the button to subscribe.

survey.descriptionLong: Allows users to help improve the content. Sends a thank you for participating in the conference and asks for an opinion about it and an indication of whether they would recommend the content to friends. The scale is from 1 to 10.

survey-emoji.descriptionShort: Email template with an emoji survey
survey-emoji.descriptionLong: Allows to collect quick feedback using a row of emoji ratings. Shows a short question above the emoji options. Sends the response directly by clicking on an emoji.

todo.descriptionShort: Email template with a list of things to do
todo.descriptionLong: Shows the monthly result of the to-do list. It contains the given activities showing which of them are you made with a specific date. Each action has a picture about the activity. It sends you with a button to set up, manage your to-do list

top-comments.descriptionShort: Email template with the top comments
top-comments.descriptionLong: Shows the most relevant and best comments that relate to the company, product, brand. This template show comments along with the author of the text. The content is clear and transparent. In addition, there is a button below for see more comments.

ui-colors.descriptionLong: Shows the available color palette in the table with codes. The colors are grouped into basic colors, social colors and variations of colors. A variety of colors allows everyone to choose something for themselves.

ui-grid.descriptionShort: Email template with a grid system
ui-grid.descriptionLong: Allows to create your own system, in which the grid is adapted. The width and length of the template depends on your preferences. Types of columns have been described with their number. The grid width adapts to the device on which it is run.

ui-typography.descriptionLong: Shows how the structures engaging the language in the tabler are shaped. Refers to the all typography. The template facilitates reading and writing in the system, not limited to one space. Additionally, shows the dimension of visual communication.

uptime-report.descriptionShort: Email template with an uptime report
uptime-report.descriptionLong: Allows to summarize the uptime and incidents of a monitored service over a period. Shows the uptime percentage along with a short list of incidents. Sends to the full report by the button.

valentines-1.descriptionLong: Template designed especially for Valentine's Day with donate a free year on the tabler. You can give it to every person. This is the best way to thank you that you are with us.The button automatically allows you to send a gift.

valentines-2.descriptionLong: Template designed especially for Valentine's Day that saves 50% of the price. Automatically calculates the discount and shows the price after the discount. This is the best way to thank you that you are with us. The button sends you to buy a product.

visitors-map.descriptionShort: Email template related with the vistitor map
visitors-map.descriptionLong: Shows using graphics from which territory visitors arrived during one week. Shows the number of page views from a given region with precise statistics. Additionally, shows how many people are using the program and how many people closed account.

welcome.descriptionShort: Email template welcoming a new user
welcome.descriptionLong: Allows to greet a new user right after they sign up. Shows a short introduction to the product along with the first steps to get started. Sends to the dashboard by the button.

wishlist.descriptionShort: Email template with a wishlist update
wishlist.descriptionLong: Allows display information about products that were not available before. It shows that the product that was in the basket is already completed in the magazine. Shows graphics with product and the amount. In addition sends a wish to the wishlist.
